paramChanges.title: Parameter Changes
paramChanges.description: Changes elements' information parameters (property sets) in the CDE and produces a new IFC version. Geometry does not change; geometry changes are made in Revit.
paramChanges.empty: No requests. To change element data in an IFC model, use “+ New Change Request”.

sets.description: A model set is a group of IFC files opened together (federated model). For each file the latest version or a fixed version is chosen; viewpoints (camera, switched-off models, class colours) are saved to the set.

setDialog.noIfc: The project has no IFC files.

tests.description: Deterministic clash test on the server with IFC geometry: hard (intersection) or clearance (distance < tolerance). On a rerun the same element pair gets the same ID; statuses are kept, and clashes that are gone become "Resolved".

ids.description: An information requirement check verifies whether the model carries the required information. Upload the IDS (Information Delivery Specification) file to the project as a normal file, then run it against an IFC version. Supported subset: entity, attribute and property facets; classification, material and partOf facets are reported as "not evaluated".
ids.truncated: The list is limited to the first {{n}} elements; the counts cover all elements.
